verdict.rationale: Orrick runs client portals, file-sharing rooms and self-service Tech Studio tools, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no user-facing retention settings or deletion controls. ISO 27001 certification, the cookie requirement on Tech Studio forms, and the Privacy-in-a-Box legal advisory service are adjacent at best and do not show users controlling retention or deletion of their own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
